source_provenance: Exploratory local run using a reconstructed harness and local feature cache; exact byte identity to checked-in source is not asserted.

protocol.models: static and temporal logistic regression with median imputation, missingness indicators, standard scaling, balanced class weights
protocol.recalibration: one-dimensional logistic (Platt) recalibration fitted only on patient-disjoint set A validation predictions; then applied once to all set B

interpretation: In this single seed, temporal discrimination exceeded static discrimination on set B; recalibration did not materially change ranking metrics.

The A-validation-trained Platt recalibrator substantially reduced Brier score and log loss on set B in this one split. This is an exploratory result only and may not transport across seeds or cohort shifts.
The validation cohort's hourly label prevalence was 2.17%, while set B prevalence was 1.41%; the difference highlights that calibration transport is a substantive risk.
Do not infer clinical calibration, clinical utility, or deployment readiness from one split.
limitations: Only seed 42 completed in this pilot; no cross-seed uncertainty interval is available.
Both cohorts are from the PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019 benchmark, not prospective clinical validation.
Hourly challenge-label metrics are not patient-level event sensitivity, lead time, or real-world false-alarm rates.
The threshold 0.5 is not clinically selected.
Exact checked-in source-byte identity has not been verified; local harness was reconstructed.
No raw records, identifiers, or row-level predictions are included.
